message.text: Paging audit taken: four Sonnet minions are mapping the page system, sorting page types, ranking overlaps, and testing whether column widths are saved per page. It lands on one growing page at ai/audits/paging/.
Paging audit, round 1: /framework/ai/audits/paging/ — map, page types, ranked overlaps, and column widths are not saved (fix is first next round).

Paging audit round 1 landed: /framework/ai/audits/paging/. Column widths are NOT saved (224px, dragged to 474px, reload back to 224px), so saving them per page is first next round. It also has the map, 7 page types, and 9 ranked overlaps (nothing merged); the page skill is updated.
The Page overview's top is now three equal columns (intro, page.js, page.jsonl), stacking on narrow screens. The preview grid below is untouched. Merged, d152a9a2.

Root cause of the Page overview spacing: the overview's own box was a bare .page grid with no flow rhythm (so the wall touched the row above it), and it stacked its own top padding on the tab panel's 3em (so the top gap doubled). Fixed by putting that box in the flow and zeroing the extra padding; the gap under the tabs went from 72px to 48px and the row now has clear air below it. No framework.css change was needed. Merged.
